text:
Jin: quick heads-up — onboarding ptq model via the new CLI, hit a burst case where funcall JSONs are mangled under load
Alex: details? which CLI flag / model?
Jin: `redwood-onboard --model fenris-liteq --quant int8 --canary --parallel 40`
Jin: repro pattern: run 40 concurrent canary invokes, ~10% of responses have truncated trailing `]` or extra `\u0000` chars so JSON.parse fails downstream
Maria: can you paste a raw example?
Jin: sure — snippet from the proxy log:
```
RECV 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z id=abc123 payload="{\"tool\":\"search\",\"args\":[{\"q\":\"redis\"}"
SEND 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z id=abc123 payload="..."
ERROR json_parse id=abc123 EOFError: unexpected end of input
```
Sam: interesting — looks like stream cutoff mid-token, maybe due to backpressure in the serving runtime while flushing KV cache
Alex: any difference if you remove `--parallel 40`?
Jin: with `--parallel 4` it's clean. With `--parallel 20` we start seeing 1-2% malformed -> scalability boundary
Maria: did you try increasing send buffer / disabling continuous batching? could be batch flush merging bodies poorly
Jin: tried `--batch-size 1` and `--no-kvcache` — failure rate drops to ~0.2% but not zero
ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T18:10 by ci/canary completed :rocket:
Sam: might be a race between the streaming layer and the serialization hook. PTQ runtime changed tokenization timing so trailing sentinel sometimes gets dropped under preemption
Alex: can we reproduce deterministically? maybe add an artificial `sleep(1ms)` before finalizing stream to simulate preemption
Jin: added a 1ms sleep in canary harness, failure spikes to 12% — confirms timing-sensitive bug
Maria: plan: 1) instrument end-of-stream boundary with a CRC or sentinel token, 2) add server-side circuit-breaker to abort partial streams and return 5xx for retries, 3) gate high parallelism for this model until fix
Alex: agree. short-term mitigation: set canary max_parallel=8 and enable client-side retry on parse failure with exponential backoff (jitter)
Sam: I'll prototype a sentinel approach — append \"__END_OF_TOOL_CALL__\" to JSON stream and strip on client. If absent -> treat as partial and throw retryable error
Jin: prototype looks promising, decreased end-to-end parse errors to 0.1% in 10k sample
Maria: also add telemetry: parse_failure_reason, raw_tail_sample, model_variant, quant_mode to canary telemetry so we can triage regressions quickly
Alex: file a short runbook for support: symptoms, mitigations (max_parallel, retries, sentinel), and who to page if rate climbs >1%
Jin: filed doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/ptq-cli-backpressure-20260315 (internal)
ops-bot: alert muted for thread by Maria
Sam: next steps I will: open PR with sentinel & circuit-breaker, add telemetry fields, and run 100k-sample stress overnight
Maria: ping me when PR is up, i'll schedule an eng-ml review and canary config change
Jin: thanks team — nice catch before this hit customer traffic
